conversation.user: My bedroom has exactly 300 sq. ft. of cold exterior wall area. If I use a 3-inch interior hemp-lime layer, what wall volume does the calculator give?
conversation.assistant: For a 300 sq. ft. bedroom wall area with a 3-inch interior retrofit layer, our planning calculator estimates about 2.5 to 3 m³ of total material volume. This natural layer acts as a vapor-permeable thermal break, stopping drafts while keeping the room breathable and free of mold. Just keep in mind these numbers are planning estimates, not stamped engineering specs. Are you currently working with brick, concrete, or wood-frame exterior walls?
